description: This file is a code generator script for the Lazy Tensor backend in PyTorch. It processes operator definitions, YAML configurations, and templates to generate C++ source and header files implementing lazy tensor operations, IR nodes, and registrations. It contains functions for parsing YAML files, validating shape inference signatures, and orchestrating the code generation process, including generating IR classes, native function declarations, and dispatcher registration code.
